metadata.name: delegation_program
metadata.description: X1 Labs Delegation Program - On-chain governance and metadata

instructions.name: acquire_epoch_lock
docs: Acquire epoch lock to prevent multiple bot instances from processing simultaneously

accounts.name: bot
docs: The bot authority that can acquire the lock

instructions.name: apply_validator
docs: Apply for the delegation program
Validators can self-register by calling this instruction.
On success the validator will be moved to the `ValidatorStatus::Pending` state

accounts.name: vote
docs: The vote account to validate - must be owned by the Vote program

accounts.name: signer
docs: The signer who is paying for the account creation and applying

instructions.name: approve_validator
docs: Approve a validator (admin or reviewer authority)
On success the validator will be moved to the `ValidatorStatus::Approved` state

instructions.name: create_validator
docs: Admin create validator (admin only)
Create a new validator account with the specified status

accounts.name: vote
docs: The vote account to validate - must be owned by the Vote program

instructions.name: force_release_lock
docs: Force release lock (admin only) - for emergency use

accounts.name: admin
docs: The admin authority that can force release the lock

instructions.name: initialize_cluster_info
docs: Initialize the cluster info account

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Initialize the delegation config account with all criteria

instructions.name: reject_validator
docs: Reject a validator (admin or reviewer authority)
On success the validator will be moved to the `ValidatorStatus::Rejected` state

instructions.name: release_epoch_lock
docs: Release epoch lock and mark epoch as processed

accounts.name: bot
docs: The bot authority that can release the lock

instructions.name: remove_validator
docs: Remove a validator (admin only)
On success the validator account will be deleted and lamports refunded to the admin

instructions.name: set_cluster_epoch
docs: Manually set the last_updated_epoch for cluster info (admin only)
This is an emergency function to manually override the last processed epoch.
Only the admin authority can call this function.

accounts.name: admin
docs: The admin authority that can manually set cluster epoch

instructions.name: transfer_authority
docs: Transfer admin authority to a new account
This is an irreversible operation. The current admin transfers
control to a new admin authority.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The current admin authority that must sign this transaction

instructions.name: update_bot_authority
docs: Update bot authority
This allows the admin to update the bot authority that can update validator criteria status

accounts.name: authority
docs: The current admin authority that must sign this transaction

instructions.name: update_cluster_info
docs: Update cluster info last_updated_epoch (bot authority only)

accounts.name: bot
docs: The bot authority that can update cluster info

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Update delegation config parameters - all fields are optional

instructions.name: update_reviewer_authority
docs: Update reviewer authority
This allows the admin to update the reviewer authority that can change validator
status (approve, reject, update_validator_status) alongside the admin authority.
Setting it to the default pubkey disables the reviewer role.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The current admin authority that must sign this transaction

instructions.name: update_stake_change_epoch
docs: Update validator's last stake change epoch (bot authority only)
This should be called when a validator's stake is increased or decreased

accounts.name: bot
docs: The bot authority that can update stake change epoch

instructions.name: update_validator_criteria
docs: Update validator criteria status for current epoch

accounts.name: bot
docs: The bot authority that must match the config bot_authority

instructions.name: update_validator_multiplier
docs: Update a validator's stake multiplier (admin only)
The multiplier is specified in basis points (10000 = 100%)
Can be set to 0 to effectively disable staking for a validator

accounts.name: signer
docs: The signer (either admin authority or bot authority)

instructions.name: update_validator_removal_score
docs: Update a validator's repeat-removal penalty score (admin or bot authority)
The score is penalty points, not a removal count: a removal for failing performance
criteria adds `strike_decay_epochs` points and every eligible epoch removes one. The
caller computes the new value; this instruction is a plain setter so the arithmetic
stays in one place off-chain.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The signer (either admin authority or bot authority)

instructions.name: update_validator_status
docs: Rewrite a validator account to the provided state (admin or reviewer authority)
Bypass the normal workflow and set validator to any state

instructions.name: withdraw_validator
docs: Withdraw from the delegation program
Validators can remove themselves by calling this instruction.
On success the validator account will be deleted and lamports refunded

accounts.name: vote
docs: The vote account being withdrawn

accounts.name: signer
docs: The signer who is withdrawing (must have authority over the vote account)

types.name: ClusterInfo
docs: Cluster-wide information for tracking delegation bot runs

fields.name: version
docs: Version of this account structure

fields.name: last_updated_epoch
docs: Last epoch when the cluster was fully processed by the bot

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for PDA generation

fields.name: locked_until_slot
docs: Slot until which the lock is held (0 if not locked)
When acquiring lock, set to current_slot + timeout_duration

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Reserved space for future use (512 - 8 = 504)

types.name: DelegationConfig
docs: Global delegation configuration parameters

fields.name: version
docs: Version of this account structure

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority that can update this config

fields.name: max_commission_percent
docs: Maximum commission percentage allowed (0-100)

fields.name: min_self_stake
docs: Minimum self-stake required from validators (in lamports)

fields.name: max_total_stake
docs: Maximum total stake per validator (in lamports)

fields.name: max_validator_stake_pct
docs: Maximum percentage of total network stake a validator can have (0-100)

fields.name: skip_rate_tolerance_pct
docs: Skip rate tolerance percentage above cluster average (0-100)

fields.name: vote_credits_threshold_pct
docs: Vote credits threshold as percentage of cluster average (0-100)

fields.name: min_validator_version
docs: Minimum Validator version required (packed as major.minor.patch)

fields.name: reserve_stake_pct
docs: Reserve stake percentage to maintain (0-100)

fields.name: max_validators
docs: Maximum number of validators to delegate to

fields.name: emergency_pause
docs: Emergency pause flag

fields.name: last_updated_epoch
docs: Last epoch when this config was updated

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for PDA generation

fields.name: stake_matching_cap
docs: Maximum stake to match 1:1 with external stake (in lamports)

fields.name: base_allocation_weight
docs: Percentage of available stake (after reserve) for base allocation (0-100)

fields.name: match_allocation_weight
docs: Percentage of available stake (after reserve) for match allocation (0-100)

fields.name: min_stake_adjustment_pct
docs: Minimum stake adjustment percentage required to trigger rebalancing (0-100)

fields.name: bot_authority
docs: Bot authority that can update validator criteria status (added in v3)

fields.name: reviewer_authority
docs: Reviewer authority that can change validator status alongside the admin authority
(approve, reject and update_validator_status). Carved out of `_reserved` so the
account size is unchanged for already deployed configs.

fields.name: strike_penalty_bps
docs: Basis points of delegation removed from a validator's ceiling per recent removal.
With 2000, one removal caps a validator at 80% of normal delegation, two at 60%.

fields.name: strike_min_cap_bps
docs: Floor for the penalised ceiling, in basis points. A validator can never be pushed
below this no matter how many times it has been removed.

fields.name: strike_decay_epochs
docs: Good epochs required to work off a single removal. Also the number of penalty points
a removal adds to `ValidatorInfo::removal_score`.
Zero disables the whole mechanism, which is what configs created before this field
existed read out of `_reserved`.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Reserved space for future use

types.name: DelegationCriterion
docs: Delegation criteria that a validator can fail

types.name: UpdateConfigParams
docs: Parameters for updating delegation config - all fields are optional

types.name: ValidatorInfo
docs: Information about a single validator in the delegation program

fields.name: version
docs: Version of this account structure

fields.name: vote_account
docs: The validator's vote account public key (used for PDA derivation)

fields.name: status
docs: Current status of the validator

fields.name: last_updated_epoch
docs: Last epoch when this validator's information was updated

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for PDA generation

fields.name: failing_criteria
docs: Vector of criteria this validator is currently failing

fields.name: stake_multiplier_bps
docs: Stake multiplier in basis points (10000 = 100%, 5000 = 50%, 20000 = 200%)
Used for stake warm-up and other delegation adjustments

fields.name: last_stake_change_epoch
docs: Last epoch when this validator's stake was increased or decreased

fields.name: removal_score
docs: Penalty points for recent removals from the delegation pool.
This is NOT a raw removal count. A removal for failing performance criteria adds
`DelegationConfig::strike_decay_epochs` points, and every epoch the validator is
eligible removes one. Divide by `strike_decay_epochs` to get the removal count
(see `strike_tier`); the value itself is the number of good epochs remaining
before the penalty is fully cleared.
Carved out of `_reserved` so the account size is unchanged for deployed validators.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Reserved space for future use

types.name: ValidatorStatus
docs: Validator status in the delegation program
